Name: LuckHarmonyPostfix
Author: Hadrix102
Description:
PostFixes the Farmer.DailyLuck getter using a Harmony patch to return values higher than 0.2 and lower than -0.2, up to 0.7499 and down to -1.
Intended for use with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14610]Configurable Luck mod[/url].
Makes it possible to set daily luck to intended modded maximum of 0.74, and intended modded minimum of -1.
For those that really want to see what the mines can offer ;)

Manifest.Name: LuckHarmonyPostfix
Manifest.Description: A simple harmony postfix patch to the Farmer.DailyLuck getter to allow values lower than -0.2 and higher than 0.2, restoring old behavior.
Manifest.Author: Hadrix102
